appearance_facts.fact: Three blue vertical bars are present, labeled 'January', 'February', and 'March'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Discharge Level Index' and ranges from 0 to 500 with labeled ticks at intervals of 100.
The top of the January bar aligns horizontally with the dashed 'Average' line, at an approximate value of 445.
The top of the February bar is below the 'Average' line, at an approximate value of 385.
The top of the March bar is below the 'Average' line, at an approximate value of 255.
A horizontal dashed black line spans the width of the chart, labeled 'Average'.

public_definitions: Goal: Review the river-discharge dashboard for the monthly monitoring cycle and assign January to the handling route that fits its discharge position relative to the monthly average level.
Chart reference: Base the routing decision on the reported monthly discharge figures shown in the dashboard when determining January's position relative to the monthly average benchmark.
Options: 'Route January to elevated discharge monitoring', 'Route January to average-band discharge monitoring', 'Route January to reduced discharge conservation review'.
uncertain: The exact numerical value of the 'Average' line is not printed, only its position relative to the bars.
The specific numerical values for the January, February, and March bars are not printed on the chart.
